transcript.en: Hi, Rob. How's the course going?
transcript.zh: 你好，Rob，最近上课感觉怎么样？

transcript.en: Oh, hi, Mia.
transcript.zh: Mia，你好。

transcript.en: Yeah, great.
transcript.zh: 我觉得非常棒。

transcript.en: I can't believe the first term's nearly over.
transcript.zh: 简直不敢相信第一个学期就快要结束了。

transcript.en: I saw your group's performance last night at the student theatre.
transcript.zh: 我昨天晚上看了你们小组在学生剧院的演出。

transcript.en: It was good.
transcript.zh: 很棒啊。

transcript.en: Really?
transcript.zh: 真的吗？

transcript.en: Yeah ...but now we have to write a report on the whole thing, an in depth analysis.
transcript.zh: 那太好了......不过我们现在得写一个报告，深入分析一下整个表演。

transcript.en: I don't know where to start.
transcript.zh: 我都不知道该从哪里下手。

transcript.en: Like, I have to write about the role I played, the doctor, how I developed the character.
transcript.zh: 比如我得写一写我扮演的这个角色——话剧里的医生，讲讲我是如何塑造这个人物的。

transcript.en: Well, what was your starting point?
transcript.zh: 你当时的出发点是什么呢？

transcript.en: Er ... my grandfather was a doctor before he retired, and I just based it on him.
transcript.zh: 嗯......我爷爷退休之前是个医生，我就是以他为人物原型塑造角色的。

transcript.en: OK, but how?
transcript.zh: 好的，不过你是怎么做的呢？

transcript.en: Did you talk to him about it?
transcript.zh: 你跟你的爷爷聊过这个角色吗？

transcript.en: He must have all sorts of stories, but he never says much about his work, even now.
transcript.zh: 他肯定经历过各种各样的事情，但是他一直都不怎么聊他的工作，即使现在也是这样。

transcript.en: He has a sort of authority though.
transcript.zh: 不过他在这方面还是蛮有权威的。

transcript.en: So how did you manage to capture that?
transcript.zh: 那你是怎么捕捉这一点的呢？

transcript.en: I'd ... I'd visualise what he must have been like in the past, when he was sitting in his consulting room listening to his patients.
transcript.zh: 我......我会想象他过去坐在诊疗室里听病人讲述病情的样子。

transcript.en: OK, so that's what you explain in your report.
transcript.zh: 哦，你可以把这个写进报告里啊。

transcript.en: Right.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: Then there's the issue of atmosphere so in the first scene we needed to know how boring life was in the doctor's village in the 1950s, so when the curtain went up on the first scene in the waiting room, there was that long silence before anyone spoke.
transcript.zh: 然后就是营造气氛了：在第一个场景，要向观众展现出二十世纪五十年代的时候，医生所在的那个村子里的生活有多么无聊。所以当第一场景的大幕拉开的时候，出现的候诊室。

transcript.en: And then people kept saying the same thing over and over, like 'Cold, isn't it?'
transcript.zh: 在有人开始说话之前那里是一阵长时间的沉默。接着人们反复说着同一句话“好冷啊，是吧？”

transcript.en: Yes, and everyone wore grey and brown, and just sat in a row.
transcript.zh: 对，而且每个人都穿着灰色和棕色的衣服坐成一排。

transcript.en: Yes, all those details of the production.
transcript.zh: 没错，所有那些作品中的细节都可以写进去。

transcript.en: And I have to analyse how I functioned in the group what I found out about myself.
transcript.zh: 我还得分析我是如何在小组中发挥作用的，通过这个节目我对自己有什么新的认识。

transcript.en: I know I was so frustrated at times, when we couldn't agree.
transcript.zh: 我只知道每次我们意见不统一的时候，我都很懊丧。

transcript.en: Yes. So did one person emerge as the leader?
transcript.zh: 嗯，那你们中有人充当领队吗？

transcript.en: Sophia did.
transcript.zh: Sophia是我们的领队。

transcript.en: That was OK she helped us work out exactly what to do, for the production.
transcript.zh: 这很棒，因为在准备作品的时候她给我们做好了分工。

transcript.en: And that made me feel better.I suppose.
transcript.zh: 这样我就觉得好多了。

transcript.en: When you understood what needed doing?
transcript.zh: 这样你就知道自己要做些什么了？

transcript.en: Yes.
transcript.zh: 是的。

transcript.en: And Sophia did some research, too.
transcript.zh: 而且Sophia还做了一些调查。

transcript.en: That was useful in developing our approach.
transcript.zh: 这在我们研究表演方法的时候非常有用。

transcript.en: Like what?
transcript.zh: 比如？

transcript.en: Well, she found these articles from the 1950s about how relationships between children and their parents, or between the public and people like bank managers or the police were shifting.
transcript.zh: 她找到了一些二十世纪五十年代的文章，关于那个时代父母和孩子之间的关系，或者大众和银行经理、警察之类的人物之间的关系是如何变化的？

transcript.en: Interesting.
transcript.zh: 有意思。

transcript.en: And did you have any practical problems to overcome?
transcript.zh: 你们当初还有什么要克服的实际问题吗？

transcript.en: Well, in the final rehearsal everything was going fine until the last scene that's where the doctor's first patient appears on stage on his own.
transcript.zh: 有，我们最后一次排练的时候，除了最后一幕一切都很顺利，最后一幕的时候医生的第一位病人要独自出现在舞台上。

transcript.en: The one in the wheelchair?
transcript.zh: 那个坐轮椅的病人？

transcript.en: Yes, and he had this really long speech, with the stage all dark except for one spotlight and then that stuck somehow so it was shining on the wrong side of the stage ... but anyway we got that fixed, thank goodness.
transcript.zh: 对，他有一段很长的独白，那时候需要把舞台全部打暗只需一道追光。但是不知道怎么回事，那一段总是出问题，追光会出现在舞台的另一边......不过谢天谢地，最后我们总算把它搞定了。

transcript.en: Yes, it was fine on the night.
transcript.zh: 是的，昨天晚上演出的时候还挺正常的。

transcript.en: But while you're here, Mia, I wanted to ask you about the year abroad option.
transcript.zh: Mia，正好你在这...我想问问你关于出国交换一年的事情。

transcript.en: Would you recommend doing that?
transcript.zh: 你推荐这么做吗？

transcript.en: Yes, definitely. It's a fantastic chance to study in another country for a year.
transcript.zh: 当然推荐了，这是个去其他国家学习一年的绝佳机会。

transcript.en: I think I'd like to do it, but it looks very competitive there's only a limited number of places.
transcript.zh: 我还蛮想去的，不过看起来竞争好激烈啊，毕竟交换名额有限。

transcript.en: Yes, so next year when you are in the second year of the course, you need to work really hard in all your theatre studies modules.
transcript.zh: 是的，所以你下个学年的时候，要非常努力地学好所有的专业课程。

transcript.en: Only students with good marks get places you have to prove that you know your subject really well.
transcript.zh: 只有成绩优秀的学生才能获得交换资格，你要向学校证明你对自己所学的科目掌握得很好。

transcript.en: Right.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: So how did you choose where to go?
transcript.zh: 你们是如何选择交换的学校的呢？

transcript.en: Well. I decided I wanted a programme that would fit in with what I wanted to do after I graduate, so I looked for a university with emphasis on acting rather than directing for example.
transcript.zh: 我当初决定学习对我毕业之后要做的工作有帮助的课程，所以我就找了找表演课很棒的大学，而不是导演课之类的。

transcript.en: It depends on you.
transcript.zh: 还是要根据你自己的情况而定。

transcript.en: Then about six months before you go, you have to email the scheme coordinator with your top three choices.
transcript.zh: 然后在出发前六个月左右，你要给课程协调员发邮件，告诉他你的前三个志愿。

transcript.en: I had a friend who missed the deadline and didn't get her first choice, so you do need to get a move on at that stage.
transcript.zh: 我有个朋友之前就是因为错过了截止日期，而没能选上第一个志愿。

transcript.en: You'll find that certain places are very popular with everyone.
transcript.zh: 所以你在那个阶段要动作快一点，因为有些地方非常抢手。

transcript.en: And don't you have to write a personal statement at that stage?
transcript.zh: 在那个阶段是不是还要写一份个人简介？

transcript.en: Yes.
transcript.zh: 是的。

transcript.en: Right.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: I'll get some of the final year students to give me some tips ... maybe see if I can read what they wrote.
transcript.zh: 好的，我会找一些最后一年的学生问问经验，也许再试试看能不能借他们写的简介参考一下。

transcript.en: I think that's a very good idea.
transcript.zh: 我觉得你这个主意很好啊。

transcript.en: I don't mind showing you what I did.
transcript.zh: 我可以把我的给你看看。

transcript.en: And while you're abroad don't make the mistake I made.
transcript.zh: 等你去了国外，千万不要犯我犯过的错误。

transcript.en: I got so involved I forgot all about making arrangements for when I came back here for the final year.
transcript.zh: 我当时太过投入了，以至于完全忘记了安排好我回来读最后一年的事宜。

transcript.en: Make sure you stay in touch so they know your choices for the optional modules.
transcript.zh: 一定要注意保持联系，这样他们才能知道你要选择哪些选修课。

transcript.en: You don't want to miss out doing your preferred specialisms.
transcript.zh: 你不会希望到时候错过你想要的专业方向的。

transcript.en: Right.
transcript.zh: 好的。
